title: Isolation of extracellular vesicle RNA from cell culture supernatant
protocol: Grow KMBC cholangiocarcinoma cells on 32 x 10 cm tissue culture plates using EV-cleared media (total 400 ml).
Incubate the cells for 48 hours.
Collect the supernatant and filter it through a 0.22 µm PES filter.
Aliquot the filtered supernatant into ultracentrifugation tubes.
Centrifuge at 100,000 x g for 70 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant after centrifugation.
Resuspend each pellet with 1 ml of PBS.
Combine washed pellets in one ultracentrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 100,000 x g for 70 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the final EV pellet with 600 µl of PBS.
Store samples at -70°C until ready for use.
Transfer 200 µl of EV into a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Add 60 µl Lysis Solution BF, vortex for 5 seconds, and incubate for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Add 20 µl Protein Precipitation Solution BF, vortex for 5 seconds, and incubate for 1 minute at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 11,000g for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Transfer the clear supernatant to a new microcentrifuge tube.
Add 270 µl Isopropanol, vortex for 5 seconds.
Assemble microRNA Mini Spin Column BF in a new collection tube and load the entire sample onto the column.
Centrifuge at 11,000g for 30 seconds at room temperature.
Discard the flow-through and return the column to the collection tube.
Add 700 μl Wash Solution 2 BF to column and centrifuge at 11,000g for 30 sec at room temperature.
Discard flow-through and return column to collection tube.
Add 250 μl Wash Solution 2 BF to column and centrifuge at 11,000g for 2 min at room temperature.
Discard flow-through and return column to collection tube.
Add 50 μl rDNase directly onto membrane of spin column.
Close lid and incubate for 15 min at room temperature.
Add 100 μl Wash Solution 1 BF to column and centrifuge at 11,000g for 30 sec at room temperature.
Discard flow-through and return column to collection tube.
Add 700 μl Wash Solution 2 BF to column and centrifuge at 11,000g for 30 sec at room temperature.
Discard flow-through and return column to collection tube.
Add 250 μl Wash Solution 2 BF to column and centrifuge at 11,000g for 2 min at room temperature.
Transfer spin column into a new collection tube.
Add 50 μl RNase free H2O directly onto the membrane of spin column.
Close lid and incubate for 1 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 11,000g for 1 min at room temperature.
Discard spin column and store purified RNA at -70°C.
Transfer 200 μl of EV into 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Add 700 μl QIAzol Lysis Reagent, vortex 5 sec, incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Add 140 μl chloroform, shake vigorously for 15 sec, incubate for 3 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge sample at 12,000g for 15 min at 4°C.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new microcentrifuge tube.
Add 500 μl 100% ethanol, mix by pipetting.
Assemble RNAeasy Mini Column in a new collection tube and load the entire sample onto the column.
Centrifuge the sample at 8,000g for 15 seconds at room temperature. Discard the flow-through and return the column to the collection tube.
Add 700 μl buffer RPE to the column and centrifuge at 8,000g for 15 seconds at room temperature. Discard the flow-through and return the column to the collection tube.
Add 500 μl buffer RPE to the column and centrifuge at 8,000g for 2 minutes at room temperature. Discard the flow-through and return the column to the collection tube.
Centrifuge the column at 8,000g for 1 minute at room temperature to dry the membrane.
Transfer the spin column into a new collection tube.
Add 30 μl RNase-free H2O directly onto the membrane of the spin column.
Close the lid and centrifuge for 1 minute at 8,000g at room temperature.
Discard the spin column and store the purified RNA at -70°C.
Transfer 200 µl of EV into a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Add 140 μl lysis buffer to the EV, vortex for 15 seconds, incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Add 80 μl 100% ethanol, vortex for 10 seconds.
Assemble spin column in a new collection tube and load the entire sample onto the column.
Centrifuge sample at 13,000 rpm for 1 min at room temperature.
Discard flow-through and return column to collection tube.
Add 400 μl Wash Buffer to column and centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 1 min at room temperature.
Discard flow-through and return column to collection tube.
Add 400 μl Wash Buffer to column and centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 1 min at room temperature.
Discard flow-through and return column to collection tube.
Centrifuge column at 13,000 rpm for 2 min at room temperature to dry membrane.
Transfer spin column into a new collection tube.
Add 30 μl Elution Buffer directly onto the membrane of spin column.
Close lid and centrifuge at 2,000 rpm for 2 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 1 min at room temperature.
Discard spin column.
Store purified RNA at -70°C.
